# invoice.
#
# More than the invoice owes, arriving as a transaction the book already holds
# and already on the receivable — so nothing has to be restated and nothing
# converted. What is missing is the question: naming several splits claims them
# all in one step, and 20.00 of the customer's money would be left over.
#
# What this fixture produces: a USD transaction with three splits, two of them
# on the receivable at −60.00 each and neither in a lot.
#

# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
